title: Food next to the glucose chart
description: Meal entries and the sensor data that is available on one timeline — for observation and for a conversation with a specialist.

blocks.text: A sensor user wants to see the time of a meal next to the measurements already taken. The quote below values being able to connect the various devices in use.

quote.text: As someone who uses both dexcom and libre I absolutely love that I can connect it to either. It’s so nice to be able to see how the foods affects your blood sugar.

blocks.text: Set one day’s entries side by side
Put meals and sensor data on a shared timeline. Keep the source, the time it arrived and the gaps visible, let a particular food entry be opened and a comment of your own added.

Two events being close in time does not by itself establish the cause of a change in a reading. The first result of a tool like this is a convenient selection to look through and discuss, without prescribing food or changing treatment automatically.
